records.rationale: All three paths read with explicit a8d9faf6f6d1 revert and 0a7537e20fc2 reapplication. Original sync wake policy is represented by the later implementation; do not replay its obsolete 0x80 enqueue flag, now colliding with native ENQUEUE_INITIAL. Final behavior and safety adaptation are assigned to the reapplication.

All three removal paths read. This was a temporary rebase revert explicitly restored by 0a7537e20fc2. Retain final Android RT sync behavior with distinct enqueue bit; neither the temporary deletion nor its old placement is needed as an additional source transformation.

All three paths read. Retain WF_SYNC propagation into enqueue flags, SMP RT-waker/priority/count predicate, same-CPU affinity-checked selection and suppression of push-list insertion for an honored sync wake. Positive compiled paths include C Binder and epoll sync wake calls; exact SDK RT traffic and measured benefit are unverified. Assign ENQUEUE_WAKEUP_SYNC=0x1000 in b1cd2b2b2792 rather than ACK 0x80, which aliases native ENQUEUE_INITIAL. This preserves native fair initial-only half-slice placement and prevents initial RT enqueue from masquerading as sync. No historical binary flag compatibility required.

All three paths read. Retain initialized-true restricted honor hook, declaration and GPL export. A false value vetoes the optimization; true still requires sync, actual execution current RT policy, priority ordering and <=2 RT tasks. Thus it cannot force honoring a hint through the boolean alone when those predicates fail. Called in selection and enqueue with their respective contexts; exact SDK registration unconfirmed, preserve vendor source control.

All three paths read. Keep wake-flag customization immediately after WF_TTWU is set, under preemption disable but before current-task special case and pi_lock acquisition. Parameter state is passed by value; flags are mutable. Trusted callback may add sync/custom hints, but must preserve required internal flag semantics and must not assume task/rq locks or sleep. No userspace callback registration path is added; exact SDK consumer unconfirmed.

Both paths read. Keep WF_ANDROID_VENDOR=0x1000 as a distinct WAKE flag and permit it in default_wake_function warning mask, alongside native WF_SYNC/WF_CURRENT_CPU. This warning is diagnostic, not authorization or enforcement. Final set_wake_flags/socket hooks were separately traced in wake-queue-history-review.json; no native algorithm interprets the vendor bit itself. WAKE and ENQUEUE domains are distinct despite the new enqueue bit using the same number. No historical raw-bit binary compatibility is preserved.

security: Preserve Android synchronous RT placement policy with explicit source hook veto. Its fast path intentionally bypasses normal RT capacity/softirq target search once current-CPU affinity and honor conditions hold; it is a scheduling policy difference with possible latency/power effects, not a verified improvement or hard-real-time guarantee. No scheduler-policy authorization check changes. Correct the flag collision so ordinary synchronous fair wakeups do not acquire native initial-task treatment and new RT tasks are not implicitly sync.
evidence: Current configured C Binder sync wake calls in drivers/android/binder.c and epoll propagation in fs/eventpoll.c are positive mechanism consumers, not proof of a particular SDK RT workload. Scoped searches in GrapheneOS system/core, frameworks/native and manifest common-modules found no named rt_sync/ENQUEUE_WAKEUP_SYNC/WF_ANDROID_VENDOR/try_to_wake_up_begin/should_honor_rt_sync consumer. These are internal names; their absence is not evidence of no Android benefit or need. Retain policy and vendor hooks conservatively.
limits: Sync is a hint, not a promise that the waker blocks immediately. should_honor_rt_sync tests actual rq->curr RT policy, not donor policy under proxying. No claim that every remote queued wake preserves all flags; current queue behavior is left unchanged and has its separate audit. Vendor wake hook runs before pi_lock, may alter internal flags, and must honor atomic context. No boot, timing, energy, latency or global scheduling correctness measurement.
validation: 32 actual place_entity host cases pass with distinct flag; old definitions fail 16 flag/placement cases, including two deadline mismatches. Model fixes nice=0, disables lag compensation and exercises feature/custom-slice/relative-deadline combinations. Source build 128 pending.
